0022600151.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, at 3-2 and second in the Central one game back, visit the Milwaukee Bucks, who are 1-4 and 14th in the East, in the sixth game of the 2026-27 season for Cleveland. The Cavaliers are 0-2 on the road but 3-0 at home and have lost their most recent game, while the Bucks are 1-2 at home and have a 1-4 record over their last ten. Meleek Thomas is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision for Cleveland, and the teams have not yet met this season, but the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 123-116 win in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
